Cơm chay tự chọn Bồ Đề Chay is a Vietnamese vegetarian canteen on Đ. 30 Tháng 4. Point at what you want, pay under $10, eat well. 4.7 stars from 234 reviews says the regulars keep coming back.

No frills. No English menu needed. Just good food at local prices.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
